sections.12-1-the-three-phases-of-healing: Healing ke teen phase: sozish (pehle din), repair (din se hafte) aur remodelling (mahine). Har phase mein rehab ki tarjeeh alag hai.
sections.12-2-acute-soft-tissue-injury-peace-and-: PEACE (foran): Protect, Elevate, Avoid anti-inflammatories, Compress, Educate. LOVE (baad mein): Load, Optimism, Vascularisation, Exercise.
sections.12-3-muscle-injury: Muscle strain aksar do-jor wali muscles mein hoti hai jo tez raftaar par lambi hote hue kaam karti hain (jaise hamstring).
sections.12-4-load-management: Chot tab hoti hai jab load tissue ki salahiyat se tez barhe. Training ka load dheere dheere barhayein aur nigrani karein.
sections.12-5-pain-monitoring-model: Pain-monitoring model: exercise ke dauraan halka dard (jaise 5/10 tak) theek hai agar agle din tak wapas normal ho jaye.
sections.12-6-questions-with-answers: Sawaal hal karein. Tendons muscle se der se theek hote hain kyunki khoon ka supply kam hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
